items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: He used to play with Kid Horry at the old Pelican dance hall

ctx.x: Right down in the pit, that's right down in the pit. Cause I had the first seat right up there by the pit, you know. I just leaned right on the rear like that and just looked right at him. And I used to go, that's where I used to sit all the time. I always made sure I got there early enough to get that seat. And that's where I used to sit and I used to watch him and I used to watch Red Happer there too. But I never seen Happer outside of the pit playing dance band. Oh yeah, when he was playing with Kid Horry. Oh…
I was going to ask if you saw Zutty, he used to beat the lyric too.
